narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On August 15, 2024, at approximately 0140 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] assisted the Hillsdale County Sheriff's Office with a traffic stop of a white sedan on M-99 near Jonesville, Michigan. The sedan carried a driver and two passengers.
INTERVIEWS:
The driver, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)], stated that he is a citizen of Guatemala and that he crossed the border near Hidalgo, Texas, in 2022. He is documented on a separate record.
The rear passenger, [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)], is the subject of this record. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Guatemala, that he has no immigration documents, and that he waded across the Rio Grande near Roma, Texas, in March 2020 and was picked up by a car on the U.S. side.
The front passenger declined to answer questions and is documented on a separate record.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
All three were transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station.
